name: Detroit Lions
status: Phase B job d6 (2026-09-23). Sort: REDESIGNED (the April 2024 set: no black, new block numbers trimmed in silver, new sleeve stripes, DETROIT on the road chest, blue-white-blue helmet stripe, Honolulu blue facemask, the 2017 lion). Colours sourced; kit albedo INFERRED. u1 2026-10-05: complete current jersey and visible shoulder 0..9 numerals from primary Nike garment photo traces; original native registration and colour/outline recipes preserved. Photo traces are measured approximations, not licensed font files.

glyph_provenance.method: Complete 0..9 measured photo traces of current Nike team jerseys sold by official club shops, accessed 2026-10-05. No marketing font used. Horizontal tilt and vertical lean flattened; measured repeated-digit perspective calibration applied only to leading numerals.
glyph_provenance.limitation: Photo-derived outlines approximate printed contours; they are not exact licensed jersey-font files. Product camera perspective and print shadows limit precision. Existing native fill/outline colours, outline fractions and registration retained.

venue.notes: Ford Field (s09; one end-zone texture serves both ends). End zones: Honolulu blue paint with white LIONS (the official wordmark) as in the 2026 week 1 photos (the other 2026 end zone says DETROIT; one texture holds one word: INFERRED choice). Midfield: the lion in full colour by hand. Signs: sign02_sign04 lion box, FORD FIELD and LIONS cut-outs redrawn; cover01 LIONS. Fan banners: 2026 content.
